description: A story featuring magical or supernatural elements as central to the world or plot.

label: Funny / Romantic Comedy
description: Romance with humor as a primary tone — banter, hijinks, situational comedy.

label: High Fantasy
description: Fantasy set in a fully fictional secondary world with extensive worldbuilding, often featuring epic stakes and elaborate magic systems.

label: Historical Romance
description: Romance set in the past — Regency, Victorian, medieval, or any historical period.

label: Horror Romance
description: Romance with horror elements designed to unsettle as much as seduce.

label: new adult
description: Focuses on characters transitioning into adulthood.

label: orcs
description: Features orc characters or cultures.

label: paranormal
description: Features supernatural beings or phenomena.

label: Paranormal Romance
description: Romance with supernatural elements — vampires, shifters, witches, fae, demons, ghosts.

label: Pirate Romance
description: A romance set among pirates, privateers, or seafaring adventurers.

label: Romance
description: A genre centered on the development of a romantic relationship and an emotionally satisfying ending.

label: Romantasy
description: A genre that blends fantasy and romance — magical worlds and significant worldbuilding with a central love story driving the plot.

label: Romantic Mystery
description: Romance interwoven with a mystery the leads must solve together.

label: Romantic Suspense
description: Romance built around tension, danger, and uncertainty driving the plot.

label: Science Fantasy
description: A blend of science-fiction and fantasy elements, such as advanced technology alongside magic.

label: Science Fiction
description: Speculative fiction based on future technology, space, science, aliens, or altered societies.

label: Sports Romance
description: Romance set within competitive sports — athletes, coaches, teams, championships.

label: Steampunk Romance
description: Romance combining fantasy or sci-fi with Victorian-era technology — gears, steam, airships, and corsets.

label: Urban Fantasy
description: Fantasy set in a contemporary, usually urban setting — magic in the modern world.

label: Vampire Romance
description: A romance with a vampire love interest — bite, bond, eternal devotion.

label: Western
description: Set in the American West or a western-inspired world, often featuring ranches, frontier towns, or cowboys.

label: Witch Romance
description: A romance centered on a witch or magical practitioner.

label: young adult
description: Written primarily for teen readers.

label: 20th Century
description: Set during the 1900s — Roaring Twenties, World Wars, mid-century, late 1900s.

label: American Civil War
description: Set during or around the American Civil War (1861–1865).

label: Ancient Times
description: Settings inspired by ancient civilizations — Egypt, Rome, Greece, Mesopotamia.

label: Contemporary
description: Set in the present day — no magic, no time travel, just modern romance.

label: Futuristic
description: Set in a future — near-future, sci-fi, post-apocalyptic, or speculative.

label: Georgian
description: Set during the Georgian era (1714–1830) — elegance, scandal, the rise of the rake.

label: Medieval
description: Set during a medieval-inspired era — castles, knights, courts, sword and crown.

label: Tudor & Stuart
description: Set during the Tudor or Stuart periods of England (1485–1714).

label: Victorian
description: Set during the Victorian era (1837–1901) — moral codes, repression, secret desires.

label: Western Frontier
description: Set during frontier expansion — cowboys, ranches, lawless towns.

label: Abduction
description: A character is taken — often by the love interest, sometimes by an antagonist.

label: academy romance
description: Romance developing within a school, academy, or training environment.

label: Age Gap
description: A significant age difference between the romantic leads — experience meets youth, or vice versa.

label: Angel
description: A story featuring an angelic or celestial character, often with divine powers, rules, or forbidden desires.

label: Arranged Forced Marriage
description: Characters are required or pressured to marry by family, politics, law, or circumstance rather than personal choice.

label: Arranged Marriage
description: Characters married off by family, court, or contract — love arrives second.

label: Assassin
description: A story featuring a trained killer, often caught between a dangerous mission and an inconvenient attraction.

label: Bear Shifter
description: Characters can shift into bears.

label: Best Friend's Brother
description: A romance with your best friend's sibling — forbidden, awkward, irresistible.

label: Best Friend's Parent
description: Romance with a best friend's parent. Forbidden, complicated, the kind of trope readers know exactly why they're here for.

label: Betrayal
description: A major breach of trust drives the story — secrets revealed, sides switched, love tested.

label: Billionaire Romance
description: A romance featuring an extremely wealthy and powerful love interest.

label: Blood Bond
description: A supernatural connection created or sealed through blood, often linking characters’ magic, emotions, or lives.

label: Bodyguard
description: One character is assigned to protect another, creating danger, forced proximity, and usually very unprofessional feelings.

label: Bonded Pair
description: Characters connected through a supernatural or magical bond.

label: Boss / Employee
description: A romance between a superior and subordinate — workplace ethics, complicated power, very motivated readers.

label: broken bond
description: A magical or emotional connection that has been damaged or severed.

label: Brother's Best Friend
description: A romance between a character and their brother’s best friend, often complicated by loyalty, secrecy, or protective siblings.

label: Bully Romance
description: A romance where one lead initially intimidates, humiliates, or mistreats the other; content warnings are especially important.

label: burn the world for her
description: a character would sacrifice everything, including morality, for their partner

label: Captive
description: A story in which a character is held prisoner or prevented from leaving.

label: Captive Romance
description: A dark-romance setup involving a captor and captive; consent and power imbalance are central concerns, so check warnings.

label: Caretaking
description: One character actively looks after another — illness, injury, emotional crisis — and the line between caretaker and lover blurs.

label: Cheating
description: Infidelity occurs within a romantic relationship — sometimes the inciting incident, sometimes the wound.

label: chosen family
description: Similar to found family, emphasizing intentionally formed emotional connections.

label: Chosen One
description: A character marked by prophecy, magic, or fate for an important role.

label: Class Difference
description: Significant economic or social class differences exist.

label: Court
description: A royal or fae social setting shaped by rulers, nobles, alliances, etiquette, and political maneuvering.

label: Court Intrigue
description: Political scheming, shifting alliances, and betrayals inside a royal or fae court.

label: court politics
description: Political maneuvering, alliances, betrayals, and power struggles among nobility.

label: Deadly Trials
description: Characters must survive lethal tests, competitions, or challenges.

label: Demon
description: A story featuring a demonic or infernal character, often dangerous, powerful, and unexpectedly romantic.

label: Dragon Rider
description: A trope where the male love interest is a dragon rider — usually in an academy or military setting, with a soul-bonded dragon and a high-stakes magical war as the backdrop.

label: Dragon Shifter
description: Characters can shift into dragons.

label: Enemies to Lovers
description: A romance in which the love interests start as antagonists — rivals, opposing sides, mutual loathing — and gradually convert that animosity into desire.

label: Enemies with Benefits
description: Characters who dislike or oppose each other begin a sexual relationship before resolving their emotional conflict.

label: Enemy Kingdoms
description: The leads belong to warring nations, courts, or factions.

label: Fae
description: Magical beings associated with fairy lore — tall, often pointed-eared, otherworldly in beauty, frequently organized into magical courts with their own powers and politics.

label: Fake Dating
description: Characters pretend to be a couple — for a wedding, a contract, family pressure — and discover the pretense is concealing real feelings.

label: Fake Engagement
description: Characters pretend to be engaged for personal, social, or strategic reasons — until pretend gets too real.

label: Fallen Angel
description: An angelic being cast out from heaven or stripped of divine status — a different kind of grace.

label: fate bound
description: Characters are connected through destiny, prophecy, or supernatural forces.

label: Fated Mates
description: A trope where two characters are magically, spiritually, or cosmically destined to be together — often with consequences for rejecting the bond.

label: Fish Out of Water
description: A character dropped into an unfamiliar world, court, or culture, learning the rules in real time.

label: Forced Bond
description: Characters linked together against their will through magic or circumstance.

label: Forced Proximity
description: A trope where characters who would otherwise stay apart are required by circumstance to be together — sharing a cabin, road trip, safehouse, or single room.

label: Found Family
description: Characters form deep family-like bonds outside of blood — chosen, fought for, protected.

label: Friends to Lovers
description: A romance that starts in established friendship and transitions into something more.

label: Friends with Benefits
description: Sex without commitment between people who like each other — until one of them stops being able to keep it casual.

label: Good Grovel
description: A character who caused harm or betrayal makes a meaningful, satisfying effort to earn forgiveness — not a quick "sorry."

label: Grumpy
description: An irritable, guarded, or emotionally reserved character—often secretly soft for exactly one person.

label: Grumpy x Sunshine
description: A pairing of one perpetually scowling character and one relentlessly warm one — the grump goes soft only for the sunshine.

label: He Falls First
description: A pacing trope where the male love interest realizes his feelings well before the heroine does.

label: he fell first
description: he caught feelings before she did. Pairs well with wine and a “she fell harder” for max impact

label: Height Difference
description: Noticeable height difference between leads.

label: Heist
description: A plot centered on planning and executing a theft, usually with a skilled crew, high stakes, and betrayals.

label: Hidden Identity
description: A character conceals their name, status, species, powers, or true allegiance from others.

label: Historical
description: Set in a past historical period.

label: Hurt / Comfort
description: One character experiences pain — physical or emotional — and another provides care and presence.

label: Insta Love
description: Characters develop romantic feelings almost immediately after meeting.

label: Jealousy
description: Romantic tension driven by fear of losing someone’s affection or by attention from a perceived rival.

label: just one bed
description: also ‘only one bed’ situation where sharing a bed is necessary by all means. (insert wink face)

label: Kidnapping
description: A character is abducted or held against their will; check content warnings for how the story handles captivity and consent.

label: Lion Shifter
description: Characters can shift into lions.

label: lost heir
description: A missing or hidden heir discovers their true identity and claim.

label: Love Triangle
description: Romantic conflict involving three people — and only one can win.

label: Lovers to Enemies
description: Former lovers become opponents through betrayal, conflict, politics, or divided loyalties.

label: Mafia Romance
description: Romance set in organized crime — loyalty, danger, blood oaths, complicated love.

label: Magic
description: Magical systems play a major role.

label: Magic School
description: An academy where characters learn to use magic, often featuring training, rivalries, exams, and dangerous secrets.

label: Marriage First
description: The characters marry before falling in love, so the relationship develops after the vows.

label: Marriage in Trouble
description: An established couple faces conflict, separation, or lost intimacy and must decide whether to rebuild their relationship.

label: Marriage of Convenience
description: Characters marry for strategy, safety, or politics — and fall in love after the paperwork.

label: Masquerade
description: A masked ball or concealed-identity event where attraction, mistaken identity, and secrets take center stage.

label: Mate
description: a romantic commitment similar to marriage

label: mated pair
description: Characters recognized as destined romantic partners through supernatural means.

label: Mentor
description: A more experienced character trains or guides another; the relationship may remain platonic or develop romantic tension.

label: Military Academy
description: A story set at a school that trains soldiers, warriors, riders, or commanders under strict and dangerous conditions.

label: Military Romance
description: Romance involving active military service or veterans — duty, deployment, coming home.

label: Monster Romance
description: A romance with a non-human or monstrous love interest.

label: Monsters
description: Stories featuring non-human creatures as central characters, threats, or romantic interests.

label: Motorcycle Club
description: A romance centered on an organized motorcycle club, often involving loyalty, danger, found family, and club rules.

label: Multicultural Romance
description: A romance involving characters from different cultural backgrounds — bridging, blending, sometimes clashing.

label: Mutual Pining
description: Both characters are in love with each other but neither has said it — sometimes neither has admitted it to themselves.

label: Mythology
description: A story drawing on gods, legends, heroes, creatures, or belief systems from cultural mythologies.

label: Necromancer
description: A magic user who communicates with, controls, or raises the dead.

label: one horse
description: characters are forced to share a single horse or mode of transportation, creating proximity

label: One Night Stand
description: A sexual encounter intended to happen once—until circumstances, feelings, or fate bring the characters together again.

label: Only One Bed
description: A setup where the characters must share a single sleeping space — by reservation error, snowstorm, hideout, or contrived circumstance.

label: Opposites Attract
description: Characters with contrasting personalities, lifestyles, or values discover they fit together better than expected.

label: Parent's Best Friend
description: Romance with a parent's close friend — they've known you since you were small. Now they're seeing you differently.

label: Pining
description: Longing for someone from a distance, often without knowing whether the feelings are returned.

label: Pirate
description: A story featuring pirates, privateers, sea voyages, treasure, danger, and romance beyond the law.

label: Political
description: A story where governance, alliances, succession, rebellion, or diplomacy significantly drives the plot.

label: Political Court Intrigue
description: Power struggles, schemes, and politics drive the plot.

label: political marriage
description: a marriage arranged primarily for power, alliances, or strategic gain

label: Pregnancy
description: A pregnancy plays a central role in the plot or relationship.

label: Quest Romance
description: A romance that ignites on a dangerous journey or mission.

label: Redemption Arc
description: A character works to atone for past wrongs and become someone better.

label: Regency
description: Set during the Regency era (1811–1820) — Bridgerton territory. Balls, scandal, marriage of convenience.

label: rejected fated mate
description: One character refuses a destined romantic bond.

label: Rejected Mate
description: A fated bond that one partner refuses, at least at first — the rejection itself becomes the wound the story heals.

label: Rekindled Romance
description: Former partners who find their way back to each other after time apart.

label: Revenge
description: A story driven by a character's pursuit of vengeance.

label: Reverse Harem / Why Choose
description: A romance where one central character has multiple love interests and does not have to choose just one; also called why choose.

label: Reverse Love Triangle
description: Multiple characters pursue the same romantic interest — the protagonist as the prize.

label: Rivals to Lovers
description: Characters competing for the same goal gradually turn rivalry and tension into attraction.

label: Road Trip
description: Romance that develops while characters travel together.

label: Royal Heroine
description: A heroine who is a queen, princess, empress, or other noblewoman whose rank shapes the story.

label: Royal Romance
description: Love among kings, queens, princes, and the thrones that complicate them.

label: Royalty
description: A story centered on kings, queens, princes, princesses, succession, court life, or royal duty.

label: Second Chance
description: Former romantic partners reconnect and attempt to rebuild their relationship.

label: Secret Baby
description: A character discovers they have a child they were previously unaware of.

label: Secret Relationship
description: Characters hide their romantic involvement from others — family, court, public.

label: Secret Royalty
description: A character who unknowingly holds a claim to a throne, title, or power.

label: Shadow Daddy
description: A hero archetype: intimidating, dark, often morally grey, with shadow- or void-based magical abilities; possessive and devoted to his love interest.

label: She Falls First
description: The heroine develops romantic feelings before the other lead does.

label: She Fell Harder
description: A companion pacing trope: when "he fell first" lands, her eventual feelings arrive with more force.

label: shifter romance
description: Paranormal romance featuring characters who shift between human and animal forms. Werewolves/wolves most common, but also bears, big cats, dragons, and basically any animal you can imagine. Often includes pack dynamics, mate bonds, and territorial behavior. May or may not include Omegaverse elements—check the blurb.

label: Short Stories
description: Brief standalone works, often collected together, that tell complete stories in fewer pages than a novel.

label: Sibling's Best Friend
description: A romance with your sibling's close friend — knew them forever, never like this.

label: Single Parent
description: A romance where one central character is raising a child or children on their own.

label: Slow Burn
description: A romance where attraction builds over a long stretch of the book — sometimes the whole book — with delayed physical resolution.

label: slow burn romance
description: Attraction develops gradually over a long period before romantic payoff occurs.

label: Slow Corruption
description: A character is gradually tempted, morally changed, or drawn toward darkness over the course of the story.

label: Snowed In
description: Characters trapped together by weather — forced proximity with a fireplace.

label: Soul Bond
description: A character who is biologically or magically destined to be the partner of another — without the lifelong commitment implication of "mate."

label: Soulmates
description: Two characters magically or spiritually bonded — sometimes telepathically, sometimes through ritual, sometimes by birth.

label: Spicy
description: Contains frequent or explicit on-page sexual content.

label: Stalker
description: A character obsessively follows or monitors another; commonly associated with dark romance and strong content warnings.

label: Step-Siblings
description: A romance between characters who become siblings through marriage — not blood.

label: Superhero Romance
description: Romance featuring characters with superpowers or hidden identities.

label: Survival
description: Characters must endure dangerous conditions to survive — isolation forges intimacy.

label: Telepathic Bond
description: A magical connection that allows characters to hear thoughts, share emotions, or communicate mind-to-mind.

label: Tiger Shifter
description: Characters can shift into tigers.

label: Time Travel
description: Characters travel through time.

label: Time-Travel Romance
description: Lovers separated or united across different eras.

label: Touch Her and Die
description: A possessive hero archetype where the love interest's extreme protectiveness becomes a threat to anyone who looks sideways at the heroine.

label: Touch Starved
description: A character has gone without affection or physical comfort and reacts strongly when safe touch is finally offered.

label: Tournament
description: Competitors face each other in a structured magical or martial contest.

label: Training Arc
description: A stretch where the protagonist is forged through structured training and earns their power.

label: True Mate
description: A shifter/paranormal variation of fated mates — the destined partner, often recognized by scent or the shifter's animal side, sometimes distinguished from a "chosen mate" picked by logic rather than fate.

label: Unrequited Love
description: One character carries romantic feelings the other doesn't return — at least not yet.

label: Vampire
description: A story featuring a vampire character, often involving immortality, blood, danger, and supernatural desire.

label: Vengeance
description: Revenge is a major motivation.

label: Villain Romance
description: A romance where the love interest is the story's antagonist — or close to it.

label: Virgin Hero
description: A male love interest who hasn't had sex before the events of the book.

label: virgin hero/heroine
description: A male/female lead with little or no prior sexual experience.

label: War
description: War or active military conflict drives part of the story.

label: Wartime Romance
description: Love that takes root during active conflict.

label: Witch
description: A story featuring a witch or magical practitioner whose powers, coven, or craft shape the plot.

label: Witches
description: Features witches or magical practitioners.

label: Workplace Romance
description: A romance between colleagues or people connected through work, often complicated by professional boundaries.

label: Epic
description: books 600 +

label: Gothic
description: Morally complex characters, darker themes, and sharp, unsettling conflict.

label: Ableism
description: Depictions of discrimination, prejudice, or harmful attitudes toward disabled individuals.

label: Abuse
description: Physical, emotional, psychological, verbal, or sexual abuse depicted within the story.

label: Abuse Between Mcs
description: Abuse occurs between the main romantic characters. A serious flag many readers want to know about going in.

label: Alcoholism
description: Alcohol dependency or addiction is depicted.

label: Animal Abuse
description: Animals are intentionally harmed, neglected, or mistreated on-page.

label: Animal Death
description: The death of an animal is depicted or discussed.

label: Birth Control Non-Consent
description: One character interferes with, removes, or deceives another regarding birth control.

label: Body Betrayal
description: A character experiences unwanted physical attraction toward someone they dislike or distrust.

label: Child Death
description: The death of a child is depicted or discussed.

label: Death Grief
description: Significant death, mourning, or bereavement is central to the story.

label: Drug Abuse
description: Misuse or addiction involving drugs is depicted.

label: Dubious Consent
description: Sexual situations where consent is unclear, impaired, pressured, or ethically questionable.

label: Eating Disorders
description: Depictions of disordered eating behaviors or eating disorder recovery.

label: Fatphobia
description: Depictions of anti-fat bias, discrimination, or body shaming.

label: Forced Pregnancy
description: Pregnancy occurs through coercion, manipulation, magical compulsion, or lack of consent.

label: Gambling
description: Problematic or significant gambling behavior is present.

label: Graphic Violence
description: Violence depicted in explicit detail — gore, torture, brutal combat.

label: Human Trafficking
description: Characters experience or are involved in forced exploitation or trafficking.

label: Incest
description: Sexual or romantic relationships between close family members.

label: Infertility
description: Difficulty conceiving or carrying a pregnancy plays a role in the story.

label: Mental Illness
description: Characters experience diagnosed or implied mental health conditions — depression, anxiety, psychosis, etc.

label: Mental Trauma
description: Characters experience significant psychological trauma — flashbacks, PTSD, dissociation.

label: Miscarriage
description: Pregnancy loss is depicted or discussed.

label: Misogyny
description: Sexism, discrimination, or prejudice against women appears in the story.

label: no hea
description: The story does not conclude with a Happily Ever After.

label: Non-Consent Between MCs
description: Sexual activity occurs between main characters without consent.

label: Non-Traditional HEA
description: The story ends positively but the ending differs from a conventional romantic resolution.

label: Past Abuse
description: A character has a history of abuse predating the events of the story.

label: Past Child Abuse
description: References to abuse experienced during childhood — character backstory.

label: Past Child Neglect
description: References to neglect experienced during childhood — backstory or memory.

label: Past Child Sexual Abuse
description: A child has a history of sexual abuse before the story begins.

label: Past Sexual Abuse
description: A character has a history of sexual abuse before the story begins.

label: Queerphobia
description: Homophobia, transphobia, or discrimination against LGBTQ+ individuals appears in the story.

label: Racism
description: Racial prejudice, discrimination, or racial violence appears in the story.

label: Rape
description: Sexual assault or rape is depicted or discussed. Always flag — readers deserve advance notice.

label: Religious Trauma
description: Psychological harm resulting from religious beliefs, institutions, or experiences.

label: Self-Harm
description: Intentional self-injury is depicted or discussed.

label: Slavery
description: Slavery exists or plays a major role in the story.

label: Slut Shaming
description: Characters are criticized, judged, or humiliated for sexual behavior.

label: Stalking
description: Persistent unwanted surveillance, following, or monitoring of a character.

label: Substance Abuse
description: Problematic use of drugs, alcohol, or other substances.

label: Suicide
description: Suicide attempts, suicide, or suicidal ideation are depicted or discussed.

label: Terminal Illness
description: A character suffers from a life-limiting or incurable illness.

label: Third Party Abuse
description: Abuse committed by a character outside the primary romantic relationship.

label: Third-Party Sexual Abuse
description: Sexual assault committed by someone outside the primary relationship.

label: Torture Of Mcs
description: A main character experiences torture.

label: Torture Of Side Characters
description: A secondary character experiences torture.

label: trigger warnings
description: alerts about potentially triggering content. usually at the front of the book or in the blurb. Use these!

label: Victim Blaming
description: Responsibility for abuse, assault, or harm is placed on the victim rather than the perpetrator.

label: Affinity
description: The specific type of magic a character can wield — elemental, mind-based, or esoteric.

label: Blood Magic
description: Magic that requires blood as a source — costly, intimate, often forbidden.

label: Blood Oath
description: A promise sealed in blood and enforced by magic.

label: Cursed Objects
description: Magical items carrying dangerous effects — heirlooms, weapons, jewelry with a price.

label: Dark Magic
description: Magic tied to death, corruption, sacrifice, or forbidden power.

label: demons
description: Features demonic beings.

label: Dragon Bond
description: The magical, telepathic tether between a rider and their dragon.

label: Dragon Riders
description: Humans bonded to dragons — telepathic link, war partner, soul match.

label: Dungeon & Quests
description: Exploration and adventure are central elements.

label: Elemental Magic
description: Magic powered by control of natural elements — fire, water, earth, air.

label: fate-bound souls
description: Destiny links characters together.

label: Gods & Goddesses
description: Divine beings directly influence events — favored mortals, divine bargains, prophecy.

label: Kingdoms & Empires
description: Large political powers drive the story — alliances, wars, succession.

label: Magic System
description: The structured set of rules governing how magic works in a world — sources, limits, costs.

label: Magical Academy
description: A school dedicated to teaching magic — Fourth Wing, ACOTAR's Night Court training, Hogwarts-adjacent.

label: Magical Creatures
description: Supernatural beings populate the world — dragons, griffins, fae beasts.

label: Mate Bond
description: The supernatural tie that marks two people as partners — by scent, fate, or magic.

label: monster hunting
description: Characters regularly fight dangerous creatures.

label: Necromancy
description: Magic of death, spirits, and resurrection — taboo in most worlds, devastating where allowed.

label: Parallel Worlds
description: Multiple realities or dimensions exist — what-ifs given form.

label: Portal Key
description: A magic-infused key that transports the bearer to a chosen place — often single-use, often pricey.

label: Portals
description: Characters travel between worlds or realms via doorways, mirrors, or magical thresholds.

label: Prophecy
description: Future events are foretold and shape the plot — the chosen one, the inevitable, the loophole.

label: Reincarnation
description: Characters reborn across lifetimes — lovers finding each other again and again.

label: Royal Courts
description: Political systems ruled by nobility — succession, alliances, scheming nobles.

label: royal politics
description: conflicts involving rulers, succession, alliances, and governance

label: Scry
description: Divination using crystals, water, blood, or tokens to find people or learn secrets.

label: Worldbuilding
description: The creation of a story’s setting, cultures, history, politics, magic, geography, and rules.
